experience.title: AI Intern
experience.summary: Developed a document redaction pipeline using Tesseract and EasyOCR to automatically detect and mask sensitive customer banking information from invoice documents, ensuring data privacy compliance. Built an automated invoice processing system using PaddleOCR and Camelot for structured table extraction, integrated with Qwen LLM to intelligently parse and extract key fields from PDF invoices. Implemented an automated customer claims validation system using Qwen Vision-Language Model that analyzes product images alongside claim details to accept or reject customer claims, reducing manual review effort. Trained a YOLOv8 Medium object detection model to identify vehicle number plates and count axles in real-time at toll gates, enabling automated vehicle classification and FASTag-based toll collection.

experience.title: Generative AI Intern
experience.summary: Built a multi-agent RAG system to automate professional proposal generation. The system analyzes RFPs, conducts research, generates content, and learns from user feedback to continuously improve. Architected a multi-agent system featuring an RFP Analysis Agent, a Scoring Agent for quality control, a Guidance Agent for strategic insights, and a Mermaid Corrector Agent for automated syntax repair. Built a dual-memory system using a FAISS vector store for RAG-based retrieval and a networkx Knowledge Graph that learns from user feedback via a JSON log to improve performance over time. Implemented a self-correction loop where a dedicated Scoring Agent evaluates AI-generated content and triggers automatic rewrites until it meets quality standards, ensuring high-relevance output. Built and deployed a real-time, AI-powered recommendation system for a professional networking platform using GraphRAG, Neo4j, and Supabase to intelligently suggest user connections and drive engagement.

experience.title: AI Intern
experience.summary: Developed an end-to-end deep learning system to predict the Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of turbofan engines using the NASA CMAPSS time-series dataset. Engineered key features by calculating RUL targets for training data and implemented data cleaning techniques to remove constant-value sensors, improving data quality. Designed and trained a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network using TensorFlow and Keras to model engine degradation patterns and predict failures. Evaluated model performance on an unseen test set, achieving a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of approximately 30 cycles, providing a quantitative measure of prediction accuracy.

experience.title: Research Intern
experience.summary: Performed audio and video-based sentiment analysis by converting speech signals into spectrogram images and extracting deep acoustic embeddings using TRILL and Wav2Vec, while leveraging ResNet and LSTM models to capture spatial–temporal features from video data for multimodal emotion understanding. Developed high-accuracy sentiment classification models on textual data, experimenting with multiple feature extraction, embedding techniques. Improved efficiency by using transformer models such as BERT and RoBERTa embedding with an LSTM architecture and achieved 99% accuracy outperforming traditional baselines.
